mike: Drafting a private offer with CloudHarbor for marketplace listing + SI co-sell. Need quick consensus on entry band, renewal credit mechanics, and hw appliance cap. @tara @olivia pls
tara: Entry band should be low friction. Suggest $40k to start. Also propose a short trial pool for champions.
olivia: From finance: tiers 40k/225k/800k with discounts 9%/14%/21%. Renewal credit as on-invoice credit, capped at 30% of next invoice. Also need blended margin by tier.
ben: Sales: add $25k trial bucket and require a minimum usage floor in first 6 months to qualify for renewal credits. Prevents gaming.
legal-bot: Heads up: appliance credits require export review; include 30-day opt-out within first 60 days; clarify "on-invoice credit" mechanics.
mike: Quick draft below. Keep comments tight:
```
CloudHarbor x Redwood Private Offer (draft)
Bands:
- Entry: $40,000 commit -> 9% discount, 6% on-invoice renewal credit, 6mo activation
- Growth: $225,000 commit -> 14% discount, 12% on-invoice renewal credit, 9mo activation
- Enterprise: $800,000 commit -> 21% discount, 18% on-invoice renewal credit, 12mo activation
Trial pool: $25k API credits for top prospects, non-transferable, expires 90 days
HW appliance credit: up to $100k per customer, subject to export/customs review; invoice credit after deployment
Renewal rules: on-invoice credits apply as line item; capped at 30% of next-year invoice; customer must meet 60% usage floor of committed units in first 6 months to apply credits
GTM: joint announcement after first paid customer go-live; co-marketing fund $25k for Growth+ commits
```
tara: Looks fine. Two asks: 1) cap HW credit per account (agree on $100k), 2) make trial non-transferable (agree).
olivia: I'll run margin calc and post numbers by EOD Thu. Also recommend a small escalation credit for multi-year deals.
ben: I'll sketch usage floor language and add a short SLA blurb for Enterprise band.
legal-bot: I'll prepare redline for opt-out and export clause by Fri; will include sample "on-invoice" clause wording.
mike: Action items: @olivia margin calc + sheet, @ben usage floor + SLA text, @legal-bot redline. Planning partner brief Tues 11am PT. Thanks everyone.
